errors.text_span: 从A1（值为0.0052）开始下降至A2（值为0.0049），然后上升至B1（值为0.0051）
errors.evidence: Description says A1 starts at 0.0052, but figure shows A1 red line starts at 0.0055. The red line does not decrease to 0.0049 at A2; it is constant at 0.0052.
Description says blue line increases to 0.0047 at B1, but figure shows B1 value as 0.0051.
The description does not explicitly state the chart compares the effect of removing bias on network density.
The description does not mention the legend, which indicates the meaning of the red and blue lines.
